rules.name: combined-var-04-legacy-inputs
rules.sql: SELECT value_date, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT invenio_product_code) AS products, sum(lot_mult IS NULL) AS null_lot_mult, sum(curr_mult IS NULL) AS null_curr_mult, sum(mult_factor IS NULL) AS null_mult_factor FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_mult_factor_view GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, curr_mult, lot_mult, mult_factor FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date = :vd ORDER BY invenio_product_code

SELECT 'cfs' AS bu, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT subportfolio) AS subportfolios, count(DISTINCT invenio_product_code) AS products, min(value_date) AS min_value_date, max(value_date) AS max_value_date FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_accounting_report_cfs UNION ALL SELECT 'rmc', count(*), count(DISTINCT subportfolio), count(DISTINCT invenio_product_code), min(value_date), max(value_date) FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_accounting_report_rmc

SELECT value_date, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, vol_id, p1_settleprice, invenio_product_code, future_expiry, option_expiry, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series, derivative_type, strike, delta, gamma, vega, theta, delta1, gamma1, vega1 FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_accounting_report_rmc

SELECT value_date, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, vol_id, p1_settleprice, invenio_product_code, future_expiry, option_expiry, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series, derivative_type, strike, delta, gamma, vega, theta, delta1, gamma1, vega1 FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_accounting_report_cfs
